test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b727ff736f352ab6da4f8407f3b26ada63295554c28f279b0262c0b133912bc.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:**

All corner symbols are shifting in clockwise direction in corner to corner.

Middle letter is replaced by new number.

**From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:**

Top-left and bottom-right symbols are interchanging their position with each other.

Top-right, middle and bottom-left symbols are interchanging their position with each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/525fbb3d0f39be95cdebfa24e42154fc13a947c7e0fb175a9a266f68e85af3f0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
